title: Nvidia's price-to-earnings ratio sinks to 7-year low as war and AI angst weigh - The Business Times
summary: Nvidia's shares are trading at their lowest valuation since early 2019 due to a combination of a broad market sell-off, fears of inflation, and concerns over AI infrastructure investments. Despite climbing gross margins and raised future earnings estimates, investor confidence is shaken.
sentiment_reason: The negative sentiment is driven by fears of inflation, potential interest rate hikes, and the impact of AI competition on profit margins, despite some positive financial indicators.
